# The attribute order of `canonical_form`, case by case: a description, then
# its form. Read by `tests/it/sdp_form.rs` against `canonical_form` and by
# `ts/pipeline/test/sdpform.test.ts` against its TypeScript twin, so the two
# order rules cannot drift apart.
#
# `=== <name>` opens a case and `---` ends its description; every line below
# is one SDP line, written with CRLF. Every live media section states its
# direction and no case holds a blank line, so the form only moves lines.

=== a direction written before a=ptime moves last
v=0
o=- 10 20 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 0 101
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
a=rtpmap:0 PCMU/8000
a=rtpmap:101 telephone-event/8000
a=fmtp:101 0-15
a=inactive
a=ptime:20
---
v=0
o=- 10 20 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 0 101
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
a=rtpmap:0 PCMU/8000
a=rtpmap:101 telephone-event/8000
a=fmtp:101 0-15
a=ptime:20
a=inactive

=== a format's fmtp written before its rtpmap moves behind it
v=0
o=- 10 21 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 18 101
a=fmtp:18 annexb=no
a=rtpmap:18 G729/8000
a=rtpmap:101 telephone-event/8000
a=fmtp:101 0-16
a=sendonly
a=ptime:20
---
v=0
o=- 10 21 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 18 101
a=rtpmap:18 G729/8000
a=fmtp:18 annexb=no
a=rtpmap:101 telephone-event/8000
a=fmtp:101 0-16
a=ptime:20
a=sendonly

=== the format attributes follow the m= format order
v=0
o=- 10 22 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 18 8
a=rtpmap:8 PCMA/8000
a=rtpmap:18 G729/8000
a=fmtp:18 annexb=no
a=sendrecv
---
v=0
o=- 10 22 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 18 8
a=rtpmap:18 G729/8000
a=fmtp:18 annexb=no
a=rtpmap:8 PCMA/8000
a=sendrecv

=== two fmtp lines of one format keep their wire order behind its rtpmap
v=0
o=- 10 23 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=video 51372 RTP/AVP 96
a=fmtp:96 profile-level-id=42e01f
a=rtpmap:96 H264/90000
a=fmtp:96 packetization-mode=1
a=recvonly
---
v=0
o=- 10 23 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=video 51372 RTP/AVP 96
a=rtpmap:96 H264/90000
a=fmtp:96 profile-level-id=42e01f
a=fmtp:96 packetization-mode=1
a=recvonly

=== two a=crypto lines keep their order, the preference they state
v=0
o=- 10 24 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=audio 49170 RTP/SAVP 0
a=sendrecv
a=crypto:2 AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_32 inline:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
a=crypto:1 AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_80 inline:BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB
a=rtpmap:0 PCMU/8000
---
v=0
o=- 10 24 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=audio 49170 RTP/SAVP 0
a=rtpmap:0 PCMU/8000
a=crypto:2 AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_32 inline:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
a=crypto:1 AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_80 inline:BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB
a=sendrecv

=== each media section is put in form on its own
v=0
o=- 10 25 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 8
a=sendrecv
a=rtpmap:8 PCMA/8000
a=ptime:20
m=video 51372 RTP/AVP 96
b=AS:512
a=fmtp:96 profile-level-id=42e01f
a=sendonly
a=rtpmap:96 H264/90000
---
v=0
o=- 10 25 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 8
a=rtpmap:8 PCMA/8000
a=ptime:20
a=sendrecv
m=video 51372 RTP/AVP 96
b=AS:512
a=rtpmap:96 H264/90000
a=fmtp:96 profile-level-id=42e01f
a=sendonly

=== a rejected stream's format attributes are regrouped and it gains no direction
v=0
o=- 10 26 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 8
a=inactive
a=rtpmap:8 PCMA/8000
m=video 0 RTP/AVP 96
a=fmtp:96 profile-level-id=42e01f
a=rtpmap:96 H264/90000
---
v=0
o=- 10 26 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 8
a=rtpmap:8 PCMA/8000
a=inactive
m=video 0 RTP/AVP 96
a=rtpmap:96 H264/90000
a=fmtp:96 profile-level-id=42e01f

=== a session-level direction stays where it is written
v=0
o=- 10 27 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
a=sendonly
m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 0
a=inactive
a=rtpmap:0 PCMU/8000
a=ptime:20
---
v=0
o=- 10 27 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
a=sendonly
m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 0
a=rtpmap:0 PCMU/8000
a=ptime:20
a=inactive

=== a format attribute the m= line does not list stays among the others
v=0
o=- 10 28 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 8
a=fmtp:18 annexb=no
a=ptime:20
a=rtpmap:8 PCMA/8000
a=sendrecv
---
v=0
o=- 10 28 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 8
a=rtpmap:8 PCMA/8000
a=fmtp:18 annexb=no
a=ptime:20
a=sendrecv

=== a description already in form is as written
v=0
o=- 10 29 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 8 101
a=rtpmap:8 PCMA/8000
a=rtpmap:101 telephone-event/8000
a=fmtp:101 0-15
a=maxptime:40
a=ptime:20
a=sendrecv
---
v=0
o=- 10 29 IN IP4 192.0.2.1
s=-
c=IN IP4 192.0.2.1
t=0 0
m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 8 101
a=rtpmap:8 PCMA/8000
a=rtpmap:101 telephone-event/8000
a=fmtp:101 0-15
a=maxptime:40
a=ptime:20
a=sendrecv
